        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_consultm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_sendagain</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_audit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_approve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_amount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_amountm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_return</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_board</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Invoice received" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_receive" name="Receive invoice in central inbox" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_inspect" name="Inspect invoice visually" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_forward" name="Forward invoice to accounting employee" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_identify" name="Identify charging supplier" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_create" name="Create invoice instance" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_checkitems" name="Check invoice items" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_consultm" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_sendagain" name="Send copy of invoice to cost center managers again" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_join" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_fwdcomm" name="Forward copy of invoice to commercial manager" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_maudit" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_audit" name="Make commercial audit" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_complaint" name="Complaint?" default="F_comp_no" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_resolve" name="Resolve complaint with supplier" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_amountm" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_return" name="Return copy of invoice and docket to accounting employee in signature file" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_pay" name="Give payment instructions" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_close" name="Close instance in ACME Financial Accounting" />
